title: U.S. House · Mississippi's 1st District
area: Northeast Mississippi, including Tupelo, Corinth, Oxford, and the Golden Triangle area

context.text: Trent Kelly ran unopposed in the March 10, 2026 Republican primary. Cliff Johnson defeated Kelvin Buck in the Democratic primary, 63.4% to 36.6%.

candidates.name: Trent Kelly
candidates.ballotNote: Ran unopposed in the March 10, 2026 Republican primary

priorities.text: Says the federal government's primary role is to keep the United States safe from threats at home and abroad.
Cites agriculture, which he says contributes $7.9 billion to the Mississippi economy, as a top priority through his seat on the House Agriculture Committee.
Says regulations from Washington have increased costs for businesses and wants to reduce that burden.

positions.summary: States on his issues page that the Second Amendment is "not up for debate" and that he will not support legislation that infringes on the rights of legal gun owners.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Agriculture, House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, and House Armed Services Committee (chair, Seapower and Projection Forces subcommittee) in the 119th Congress.

candidates.name: Cliff Johnson
candidates.currentRole: Civil rights lawyer and law professor

priorities.text: "Working People Matter": says flat wages and rising prices for groceries, housing and health care are squeezing North Mississippi families while tax cuts go to the wealthy.
priorities.quote: Working People Matter! Too many people in North Mississippi are struggling to make ends meet, and politicians aren't doing enough to make things easier.

priorities.text: "Democracy Matters": says the politicization of the military, attacks on the judiciary, and dismantling of government agencies threaten checks and balances.
"Independence Matters": describes himself as a lifelong Democrat dedicated to Mississippians rather than to a political party.

statements.quote: Insurance is unaffordable for too many, and tens of thousands of Mississippians who have insurance through Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act are about to lose coverage.
statements.context: In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2025)

statements.quote: the Trump Administration and politicians who support it are focused on giving tax cuts to the super-rich and making sure corporations continue to enjoy record profits.
statements.context: In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2025)

candidates.researchNotes: Positions beyond his survey and campaign website (cliffjohnsonforcongress.com, which has no issue pages) were not found; a search summary mentioning a $15 minimum wage could not be confirmed from a page and is not included.

candidates.name: Johnny Baucom

priorities.text: Says he will not approve spending increases without offsetting restrictions elsewhere or raises for Congress.
priorities.quote: I will not approve anything that comes at the expense of the taxpayer. No expansion of budgets without restrictions made elsewhere, no raises for congress

priorities.text: Says his first legislative target is ending the EU Deforestation Regulation as part of a deregulation push.
priorities.quote: While in office I will be working heavily with other members of congress in deregulation.

priorities.text: Lists firearm deregulation, taxation and full federal legalization of marijuana among his policy interests.
priorities.quote: Firearm deregulation, Taxation, full federal legalization of marijuana.

positions.summary: In his Ballotpedia survey he lists firearm deregulation among his policy interests and calls firearm ownership a right.
positions.quote: Defending your life and property with a firearm of your choice is an inherently American right, unbarred.

statements.quote: Income, and property taxes are unconstitutional, and reprehensible. The full abolition of the IRS is the only proper step forward in American liberation.
statements.context: In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)

candidates.researchNotes: Positions and priorities come from his 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey. No campaign website found. His survey also says he opposes government aid to foreign entities, which was not mapped to the Israel-aid issue because it does not name Israel.

sources.title: Cliff Johnson - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey
Johnny Baucom - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey

researchNotes: Basic-tier research.
